entries.name: DetectAsymOn
entries.summary: Graphs check for asymptotes and don't join across them (slower).

entries.name: DetectAsymOff
entries.summary: Graphs don't look for asymptotes (faster).

entries.name: Time
entries.summary: Sequence graphs plot against n.

entries.name: Web
entries.summary: Sequence graphs as cobweb plots.

entries.name: uvAxes
entries.summary: Sequence graphs plot u(n) against v(n).

entries.name: uwAxes
entries.summary: Sequence graphs plot u(n) against w(n).

entries.name: vwAxes
entries.summary: Sequence graphs plot v(n) against w(n).

entries.name: Thick
entries.summary: All Y= functions drawn with thick lines.

entries.name: Thin
entries.summary: All Y= functions drawn with thin lines.

entries.name: Dot-Thick
entries.summary: All Y= functions drawn as large dots, not joined.

entries.name: Dot-Thin
entries.summary: All Y= functions drawn as small dots, not joined.

entries.name: Radian
entries.summary: Angle mode: radians.
entries.notes: Calculus and most physics want radians.

entries.name: Degree
entries.summary: Angle mode: degrees.

entries.name: Normal
entries.summary: Numbers shown normally (scientific only when needed).

entries.name: Sci
entries.summary: Numbers shown in scientific notation.

entries.name: Eng
entries.summary: Numbers shown in engineering notation (powers of ten in steps of 3).

entries.name: Float
entries.summary: Show as many decimal places as needed.

entries.name: Fix
entries.summary: Show a fixed number of decimal places.

entries.name: Func
entries.summary: Graph mode: functions y=f(x).

entries.name: Param
entries.summary: Graph mode: parametric x(t), y(t).

entries.name: Polar
entries.summary: Graph mode: polar r(θ).

entries.name: Seq
entries.summary: Graph mode: sequences u(n), v(n), w(n).

entries.name: Sequential
entries.summary: Graphs drawn one function at a time.

entries.name: Simul
entries.summary: Graphs drawn all at once.

entries.name: Full
entries.summary: No split screen.

entries.name: Horiz
entries.summary: Split screen: graph above, home screen below.

entries.name: G-T
entries.summary: Split screen: graph and table side by side.

entries.name: MATHPRINT
entries.summary: Mode: math shown in textbook form (fractions, exponents raised).

entries.name: CLASSIC
entries.summary: Mode: input and output on one line, as typed.

entries.name: AUTO
entries.summary: Answers in the same form as the input (fraction or decimal).
entries.notes: Shown as "AUTO Answer".

entries.name: DEC
entries.summary: Answers as decimals.
entries.notes: Shown as "DEC Answer".

entries.name: FRAC-APPROX
entries.summary: Answers as fractions when possible.

entries.name: IndpntAuto
entries.summary: The table fills in x values itself.

entries.name: IndpntAsk
entries.summary: The table asks for each x value.

entries.name: DependAuto
entries.summary: The table works out y values itself.

entries.name: DependAsk
entries.summary: The table works out a y value only when you ask.

entries.name: SEQ(𝑛)
entries.summary: Sequence editor type u(n)= (OS 5.2+).

entries.name: SEQ(𝑛+1)
entries.summary: Sequence editor type u(n+1)=.

entries.name: SEQ(𝑛+2)
entries.summary: Sequence editor type u(n+2)=.

entries.name: ClockOn
entries.summary: Shows the clock in the status bar.

entries.name: ClockOff
entries.summary: Hides the clock.

entries.name: isClockOn
entries.summary: 1 if the clock is shown, 0 if not.

entries.name: setDate(
entries.summary: Sets the clock's date.

entries.name: setTime(
entries.summary: Sets the clock's time (24-hour).

entries.name: setDtFmt(
entries.summary: Date format: 1 M/D/Y, 2 D/M/Y, 3 Y/M/D.

entries.name: setTmFmt(
entries.summary: Time format: 12 or 24 hour.

entries.name: getDate
entries.summary: Today's date as {year,month,day}.

entries.name: getTime
entries.summary: The time as {hour,minute,second}.

entries.name: getDtFmt
entries.summary: The date format number (1-3).

entries.name: getTmFmt
entries.summary: The time format (12 or 24).

entries.name: getDtStr(
entries.summary: Today's date as text in a chosen format.

entries.name: getTmStr(
entries.summary: The time as text, 12 or 24 hour.

entries.name: startTmr
entries.summary: The clock in seconds, to start a timer.

entries.name: checkTmr(
entries.summary: Seconds since a value from startTmr.

entries.name: timeCnv(
entries.summary: Splits seconds into {days,hours,minutes,seconds}.

entries.name: dayOfWk(
entries.summary: Day of the week, 1 Sunday to 7 Saturday.

entries.name: Archive
entries.summary: Moves a variable to archive (flash), safe from RAM resets.
entries.notes: Archived variables can't be used until UnArchived (programs can run).

entries.name: UnArchive
entries.summary: Moves a variable from archive back to RAM.

entries.name: Clear Entries
entries.summary: Clears the home screen's entry history.

entries.name: GarbageCollect
entries.summary: Tidies the archive to free space.
entries.notes: Can take a while; asks to confirm.
